summary: Offering a human corpse on the non-high neutral altar reaches sacrifice_your_race(): C calls angrygods() before applying the subsequent Luck penalty, but JavaScript records pray.c angrygods as unported and skips it. The omitted call causes the step-40 RNG and screen divergence; the C anger roll selects cases 7/8, which also require minion.c summon_minion for the step-41 replay.

source.branch: A non-chaotic hero outside Gehennom offers a corpse of their own race on a non-high neutral altar. sacrifice_your_race() increases u.ugangr by 3 and calls angrygods() before change_luck(-5); in this recording rn2(maxanger) returns 8, selecting angrygods() cases 7/8.
callers: sacrifice_your_race() -> angrygods(): nethack-c/upstream/src/pray.c:1765-1771; js/pray.js:662-668, where the call is currently skipped with note_unported().
dependencies: minion.c:summon_minion; angry gods cases 7/8 call it, and the assigned recording reaches this branch at step 41.

evidence: challenges/evaluations/baseline-9f590c88f193a980f8f819ebfad051a65f36faa0-v29.json records 40/54 screens matched and the first mismatch at step 40: C rng entry rn2(9)=8 from angrygods(pray.c:725), while the positional JavaScript entry is rn2(5)=0; the C screen is blank at row 0, column 38 where JavaScript has a dash. The queue records 14 remaining screens for recording e6a5efe57d2c9183baafa65049874604fa7c4d9f26ff3e09da54bd3d0fa634b9.

The permitted single-case replay, node scripts/scan-sessions.mjs --json --synthetic v29/v29-sacrifice-human-race, reproduces the step-40 divergence and lists pray.c angrygods in the runtime unported set. The JavaScript rn2(5) is the next positional RNG entry after the skipped C call, not a roll attributed to angrygods.

nethack-c/upstream/src/pray.c:1698-1778 shows the human-race offering path; at lines 1765-1771 the non-chaotic branch changes alignment, increments u.ugangr, calls angrygods(u.ualign.type) outside Gehennom, and only then calls change_luck(-5). js/pray.js:589-683 mirrors the caller but uses note_unported("pray.c angrygods") at line 666 before change_luck(-5), explaining the absent C behavior.

nethack-c/upstream/src/pray.c:704-784 defines angrygods(); rn2(maxanger) at line 725 selects cases 7/8 in this recording, which call godvoice(), verbalize the threat, and summon_minion() at lines 760-772 before the shared timer update. js/pray.js:2306-2385 currently throws UnsupportedPrayerError for cases 7/8 at lines 2377-2379. The recording step 41 includes the summon and subsequent angry-god RNG calls; nethack-c/upstream/src/minion.c:198 is the required callee owner.
